excluded.why: DJ's public Yahoo profile lists every league that account ever played. In 2012 it holds exactly two, both 10 teams - 'Skol Vikes' 4th and a Yahoo Public league 8th. No FL Players. 'FL Players' appears five times in his whole history (2008, 2009, 2010, 2011, 2013) and 2012 is not one of them. PackNation's owner account is also (Since '12) Bronze 544, while DJ's is (Since '07) Bronze 552 - different accounts. He was assigned this team on 2026-11-16 by elimination and the assignment was reversed on 2026-11-17 (commit 9af531b). Elimination will keep re-proposing him because removing his 2012 team is what makes him 'unaccounted for' in 2012. It assumed he played every season between his first and last; he sat 2012 out.
